spec.description:
Rhino Wrap Breather is a micro-perforated or permeable
reflective foil laminate engineered for external wall and building applications.
Combining high-tensile polypropylene woven scrim with a pure aluminium
reflective surface, it reflects radiant heat while micro-perforations permit
moisture vapour diffusion. It serves as a weather barrier and radiant heat
reflector across framed external walls in warm and temperate Australian climate
zones.
features:
Reflective aluminium foil surface reflecting up to 95%
of radiant heat

Woven polypropylene scrim delivers high tear and puncture
resistance
Breather perforations allow controlled moisture vapour diffusion
Functions as a weather barrier against wind-driven rain and dust

Tough
Medium Duty classification withstands wind loads on site

Resistant to
delamination, shrinkage, and moisture degradation

Low Flammability Index
compliant with AS 1530.2

Suitable for bushfire-prone areas up to BAL-40 to
AS 3959
spec.fire:
Flammability Index ≤ 5 to AS 1530.2; Suitable for external walls in
bushfire-prone areas up to BAL-40 under AS 3959
spec.compliance:
AS/NZS 4200.1:2017, AS/NZS 4200.2:2017, AS 1530.2, AS 3959, NCC Volume One and
Two
spec.sustainability:
Recyclable polymer and aluminium materials; zero ODP;
non-toxic
install:
Install horizontally on external wall studs starting
from the bottom plate

Fasten with broad-headed galvanised clouts or staples
at maximum 300mm centres

Ensure upper sheets overlap lower sheets by at
least 150mm to shed water

Maintain a minimum 20mm still air cavity adjacent
to the reflective face to achieve thermal R-values

Tape all laps and
penetrations with reinforced aluminium foil tape

Seal neatly around window
frames, door openings, and service penetrations

Install external cladding
over a drained cavity
selection_checklist:
Confirm wall assembly allows
for a minimum 20mm reflective airspace

Verify climate zone permits
micro-perforated breather foil (warm to temperate zones)

Calculate roll
requirements based on wall area allowing 150mm overlaps

Order matching
reinforced aluminium foil joining tape
limitations:
Requires an adjacent sealed air space of at
least 20mm to deliver thermal R-value

Not recommended for cold climate zones
requiring non-perforated Class 4 spunbond wraps

Do not use as direct roof
sarking without appropriate fall and drainage

use_cases:
Reflective thermal wall wrap on residential
brick veneer in warm and temperate Australian climate zones

Tear-resistant
reflective wrap on timber and steel framed sheds and domestic garages

Radiant
barrier behind lightweight external cladding with a ventilated airspace
not_for:
Cold climate zones (Zones 6 to 8) requiring Class 4 non-woven
permeable membranes
retrieval.rag_summary:
Misc Rhino Wrap Breather is a Medium Duty
reflective foil wall sarking manufactured from high-tensile woven polypropylene
laminated to pure aluminium foil with micro-perforations. Designed for external
framed walls, it reflects up to 95% of radiant heat across an adjacent air
cavity while allowing moisture vapour to breathe outward. Complying with
AS/NZS 4200.1:2017 and possessing a Flammability Index ≤ 5 (BAL-40 suitable), it
delivers tear-resistant weather protection and thermal reflectance for
residential and shed construction.
